programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Die Entdeckung eines Dinosaurierfossils, das so gut erhalten ist, dass es die Struktur, die Muster und die Farben eines prähistorischen Riesen zeigt. Entdecken Sie eine brandneue Spezies, die in der späten Jura- und in der Kreidezeit lebte.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Der Tyrannosaurus Rex ist bekannt als der König der Dinosaurier – aber wie begann seine Herrschaft? Hier kommt Moros Intrepidus ins Spiel, ein 80 Kilo schwerer, hirschgroßer Vorfahre des T-Rex.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Könnte ein 75 Millionen Jahre alter Dinosaurierschädel, der seit über 20 Jahren in einem Museum liegt, die allererste von Menschen entdeckte Dinosaurier-DNA enthalten? Ein internationales Team von Wissenschaftlern versucht das Geheimnis zu lüften.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Löwen mögen als die Könige des Dschungels bekannt sein, aber es waren Säbelzahnkatzen, die über Amerika herrschten. Neue Fossilfunde werfen ein Licht auf das gewalttätige Leben dieser mysteriösen Spezies.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Durch die Untersuchung zahlloser Megalodon-Zähne aus der ganzen Welt sind die Wissenschaftler zu dem Schluss gekommen, dass „Meg“ seine gigantischen Ausmaße erreichen konnte, indem er schon früh damit begann, Fleisch zu fressen – im Mutterleib.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Vor 65 Millionen Jahren schlug ein riesiges Weltraumgestein auf der Erde ein und verursachte das Äquivalent eines nuklearen Winters, der alle Dinosaurier tötete. Jetzt glaubt ein Team von Wissenschaftlern, dass es einen Zeugen der Katastrophe gab.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Lange ging man davon aus, dass der Mensch Nordamerika vor etwa 15.000 Jahren als letzten Kontinent besiedelte. Neue Funde deuten auf eine frühere Besiedlung hin, möglicherweise über Routen, die heute tief unter dem Meer begraben sind.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Wie lange dauert es, bis sich das Leben nach einem großen Massenaussterben erholt? Wissenschaftler finden in Fossilien im norwegischen Svalbard überraschende Erkenntnissen über die Geschichte unserer Erde.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Vor fast einem Jahrhundert wurde der Tasmanische Tiger vom Menschen ausgerottet. Nun wollen ihn Genetiker wieder zum Leben erwecken.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Archäologen und Genetiker enthüllen überraschende Details über eine geheimnisvolle Zivilisation, die vor den Inkas Südamerika bewohnte. Nur wenige haben von den Chachapoya gehört, einem Volk, das als Wolkenkrieger bekannt ist.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Der Ausbruch des Vesuvs im Jahr 79 v. Chr. ist vor allem wegen der Zerstörung der Stadt Pompeji weltberühmt. Doch auch eine nahegelegene römische Siedlung namens Herculaneum fiel dem Vulkan zum Opfer, wurde aber weniger stark zerstört.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Vor 66 Millionen Jahren löste ein Asteroideneinschlag auf Yucatán das Dinosaurier-Massenaussterben aus. Angesichts von 700.000 Asteroiden stellt sich die Frage, was passiert, falls so etwas erneut geschieht.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Ist es denkbar, dass es in unserem Sonnensystem einen Planeten gibt, von dem wir noch nichts wissen? Vielleicht sogar mehrere? Neue Erkenntnisse deuten darauf hin, dass es einen 9. Planeten, oder auch Planet X genannt, tatsächlich geben könnte.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Für das 'Event Horizon Telescope' verbanden Astronomen weltweit Radioteleskope und fotografierten das supermassereiche Schwarze Loch im Zentrum der Milchstraße. Sagittarius A* ist über vier Millionen Mal massereicher als die Sonne.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: 2020 schickt die NASA den Mars-Rover Perseverance auf die Mission herauszufinden, ob es früher Leben auf dem Roten Planeten gab. Begleitet vom Mini-Helikopter Ingenuity soll er Spuren mikrobiellen Lebens finden.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Die Landung von „Perseverance“ auf dem Mars ist historisch: Spannung, jahrelange Planung und bahnbrechende Technik, inklusive des ersten Mars-Helikopters.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Wasserknappheit wird in vielen Regionen der Erde zu einem immer größeren Problem. Die jüngste Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters im Gestein vor der US-amerikanischen Küste könnte eine große Hoffnung für die Menschheit sein.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED

programme.title: Made in...

programme.title: Made in...

Sie entwickelt und baut Fahrzeuge, die sowohl auf der Straße wie auf der Rennstrecke gefragt sind.

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: Kiekert aus Nordrhein-Westfalen ist ein Lieferant für viele verschiedene Schließsysteme und Marktführer bei Autotürschlössern. Kunden aus aller Welt kaufen bei Kiekert Türschlösser, die das Auto vor Diebstahl schützen, das Öffnen der Türen während der Fahrt verhindern und im Falle eines Unfalls eine lebensrettende Funktion haben. Ihre Qualität wird von Kiekert ständig verbessert.

programme.title: Made in...

programme.title: Made in...

Neben der großen Qualität stehen Mercedes-Benz-Fahrzeuge auch für Sicherheit. Der Mercedes-Stern ist das wichtigste Kennzeichen der Mercedes-Benz-Autos. Der Name 'Mercedes-Benz' gilt auf der ganzen Welt als Inbegriff für Tradition und Innovation für die Zukunft des Automobils.

programme.title: Made in...

Firmengründer Burkard Bovensiepen legt in den 60er Jahren den Grundstein hierzu. Heute führt er gemeinsam mit seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian dieses Gesamtkunstwerk.

programme.title: Made in...

Die Rolls Royce-Fabrik in Goodwood, England: Als ein Teil der BMW Group, arbeitet Rolls Royce bei der Produktion selbstverständlich nach den gleichen Prinzipien.

programme.title: Made in...

programme.title: LBP Spotlight
programme.desc: Michael and Larken are a father and son duo from NC who have a passion for the out doors and passing down family traditions.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Air Force veteran Dr. David Tharp & Army veteran Scott Meador - recount their struggles post military and the help they offer through their non-profit, Project Healing Heroes.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Southards continue their family tradition on Table Rock Lake. While they’re there, Trenton spends a day with “Mr. Worldwide” James Watson and learns some things from one of the best anglers on the lake.

programme.title: Saltwater Underground
programme.desc: Nick visits the Crystal Coast of North Carolina to search out redfish and seatrout in the backwaters with Capt. Joe Tunstall and Capt. Chris Kimney.

programme.title: Sportsman's Journal
programme.desc: We head up to Lake of the Woods in search of monster crappies through the ice!

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny tries his hand at being a guide on the Manistee River with Koz. Then later Danny tries his fly fishing skills on the Crystal River to see if he can land a monster salmon on the fly.

programme.title: Baitfuel Fishing Tournament
programme.desc: Day 1 of the Baitfuel Fishing Tour Championship starts at Joel Stone Heritage Park in Gananoque, Ontario on the mighty St. Lawrence River and Lake Ontario.

programme.title: Fly Shop Tour
programme.desc: We kick off Season 2 in Tennessee where we stop in Nashville, Townsend, and Johnson City!!

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Captain Mike travels to the "Forgotten Coast" to fish Keaton Beach for the first time with the legendary Captain Greg DeVault.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Col. Nick Nichols from Folds of Honor and Olympic skeet shooter Dania Vizzi are both proud Americans who have represented their country overseas. Col. Nichols commanded the air in the cockpit of a fighter jet for countless missions during his seven combat tours and Dania donned the stars and bars proudly on her shooting vest as an Olympian in Paris. Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode of Hunting Land Man, Asa is on a roll. She fills her second and third turkey tags of the year, capping off an incredible season and tagging out in Mississippi. The highlight of the week came when she got to experience her very first double-up with her dad, Slade. Sharing a moment like that in the turkey woods is something they'll never forget, making this a truly unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. As this is Asa's first time turkey hunting some quick pre hunt preparations are in order. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Michael Pitts shares his 2023 turkey gun setup. It's a Franchi Affinity 3 paired with a Bushnell red dot and Federal TSS. This combo is havoc on the longbeards. To get everyone fired up about Florida this weekend, we're gonna also throw it back to a couple awesome Osceola hunts we've had in the past.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Michael Pitts and MLB player Austin Riley hunt tough conditions and henned-up Florida gobblers. The opening week of the Florida turkey season makes them work for it.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Realtree's Ben McDonald gets luck again on his first sit in Nebraska. This time he rattles in an absolute giant whitetail into Bow Range.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Opening Day of Deer Season 2023 is finally here and the Realtree Road Trips crew is ready to hit the whitetail woods bow hunting in Nebraska. It's unseasonably hot but the bucks are still hitting the fields before dark. Follow along daily as the guys chase these Nebraska monster bucks!!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Riley Green heads down to South Louisiana to finish out duck and deer season. The first morning duck hunt was absolutely epic with a 7 man limit at 7:35 am. Day 3 in the deer blind proved to be all Riley needed to close out his deer season with a big, wide 10 point!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: 9/3/23: - Day 3 in Nebraska and despite the extreme heat the bucks are on their feet. Michael Pitts, Ben McDonald and Bryan Brown hit the woods hoping to fill their opening week tags.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Ben McDonald heads back to Nebraska this time to freezing temp and snow. Ben is after a huge bodied buck that has started to show up on trail cameras. He is hoping the first time into the area is the charm as he bow hunts this Nebraska Giant Buck!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: After a successful opening weekend, the crew heads out to work on controlling the doe population only to have an encounter with a huge 8-pointer. Should Bryan Brown have shot?

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Join us for an unforgettable Women Go Hunting experience at Legends Ranch in Michigan!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven working on some Big Tine clover maintenance and getting the plot he killed the Boss 8 in during rifle season ready to go. Tune in and get some tips for your clover plots and watch Randy take out the oldest deer on the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are in Missouri at the Raven and they are ready to burn some powder and get rifle season kicked off at the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

programme.title: Widower Syndrome
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal car accident a year ago, Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone. A race of desperation to find the truth, may also reveal Xavier’s own sanity.

programme.title: Undercover Consequences
programme.desc: Caught in-between two worlds, Pharaoh has to decide what's more important to him... taking the righteous path...or living the street life. Being loyal to the love of his life, or being loyal to the game.

programme.title: Weapons of Warfare
programme.desc: When 19 year old TJ, decides to leave the nest of his parents who are preachers of the gospel and turns to the streets for the love and support he always wanted. His life is turned upside down almost over night with gun violence, drug dealings, stolen money and countless crimes in the blink of an eye. His life becomes a tug of war between the parents that raised him and his new gang leader chief Who’s bringing him further down to the ground.

programme.title: Twisted Games
programme.desc: Tyler seeks revenge on a college classmate who he believes stole his girlfriend, Enna. Tyler returns to their hometown, reenters his old classmates lives, and begins unleashing dark secrets regarding Marcus, Enna, and Marcus' wife Lisa.

programme.title: Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria moves from out of town into the poor inner city of New York with her father, the neighborhood drug dealer. She goes on a journey seeking answers, justice, and revenge after her father was murdered by local competition. In the process of her revenge, Victoria realizes that she doesn't want to live the lifestyle that she is living before it becomes too late.

programme.title: Asking for a Friend
programme.desc: A successful engineer struggles in the love department. In denial that his girlfriend is cheating on him, Jeff gets teased by his homeboys until they convince him to try this new dating app and get back out there prove his value to his girlfriend.

programme.title: BARS
programme.desc: Kobe lives a picture-perfect life. A devoted wife and mother, she has everything she's ever wanted. But her idyllic world shatters when she's abruptly arrested and sentenced to life in prison for a crime she didn't commit. Desperate for survival, Kobe finds solace and strength in a tight-knit group of inmates known as The Pretty Girls. Unaware of Kobe's ordeal, her twin sister Shaq returns home only to discover the shocking truth.

programme.title: 10 Reasons Why Men Cheat
programme.desc: In the wake of a wedding catastrophe, three couples discover the meaning of commitment, while discussing what women want to know most of all when it comes to men and relationships. WHY DO MEN CHEAT?

programme.title: Below the Belt
programme.desc: Childhood best friend Crim and David fall in love and marry Jackie and Lakeisha, who are also best friends. David and Lakeisha’s marriage is on the rocks after lack of intimacy, while Jackie and Crim are doing amazing. Some time passes and it’s revealed that Lakeisha and Crim are having an affair. Lies, betrayal, and pain are thrown around. Will these marriages and friendships survive?

programme.title: Busted and Disgusted
programme.desc: Two sisters, Faith and Promise, overcome their difficult childhood following the death of their mother to cancer. Faith has it all, a successful career and a loving husband, but Promise feels threatened by her older sister’s success, and seeks to claim her happiness for herself.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she’s always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she’s truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: Maverick Movie
programme.desc: War has begun after Mafia Kisses launches a violent ambush against GMB’s East warehouse.

programme.title: Maverick Movie
programme.desc: The war for Dallas continues as Gotti secures a partnership with Mojave, and Mafia Kisses aligns with new suppliers and hidden players that can expose the entire operation.

programme.title: Knee Deep The Series: It's Not Over...
programme.desc: New international players enter the game as the war expands beyond Dallas. With trust shattered and power shifting, one truth becomes unavoidable – this battle is far from finished.

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their search for truth spirals into obsession, revenge, and deadly consequences.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

Chip, gracias a su libro, descubre que el volcán emitió una base que, al mezclarse con el ácido, puede neutralizar el peligroso lago y convertirlo en una agradable extensión de agua salada.

programme.title: LMN's

Pero ahora, el Dr. No ha desviado el flujo de amoníaco para su propio beneficio. Chip descubre el punto donde se desvía el amoníaco y construye una presa que lo devuelve a su curso normal.

programme.title: Fresh Quilting
programme.desc: Control is not the first word that comes to mind when thinking of modern quilting, but there are some techniques that can benefit by keeping things under control. Catherine Cureton illustrates the idea of controlled scrappy quilting. She has a new method for sorting fabrics that allows for stress free scrappy quilting. Then, Audrey Esarey has the guide for sewing curves. Keep stitching under control with some simple tips for curves. Then it's tips for walking foot quilting with Eliane Bergmann in the machine tip.

programme.title: Color Block Drunkard's Path Quilt
programme.desc: We're having trouble seeing straight. Then again, it's probably the Drunkard's Path block! Angela's here to make sure the steps go "straight to your head."

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: The Walters household is eating healthy this week, but that doesn't mean Angela's quilts have to be. Today she is whipping up the Milky Way Quilt by Monique Dillard featuring Lily & Loom fabric.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: During World War II, feminine fashion took on a more masculine look. But women added feminine touches. Joann Banko creates embroidered lingerie. Then Heather Valentine shows how to top off boots with a lacey cuff. Joanne Banko adds beads and trims with the pearls and sequin foot.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Color adds an extra pop to any jewelry design. Designer and author Amee Sweet-McNamara blends her love of colors and shapes with soutache braid and tiny beads to create high-impact jewelry. Katie colors charms and pendants using permanent markers and alcohol inks.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: If one page is good, a whole bunch is better. This show focuses on books. First, host Julie Fei-Fan Balzer uses colorful paint pens to create an art journal page of doodled leaves. Next, Joe Rotella shares secrets of book binding demonstrating a piano hinge style binding. Then, Stacy Julian makes a treasures theme album with gold glittery elements. Last, Julie uses an electronic cutter to make numerous triangle shapes to embellish a cover for an album.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Get out those paints and brushes and let's paint! Collage artist Rebekah Meier uses custom-cut stencils, masking tape and paints to create a cool canvas. Dina Wakley uses thick and thin paint methods to make an artistic journal page. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer works with additive and reductive mono-printing techniques. In the tip, Seth Apter shares innovative embossing ideas.

programme.desc: Hollywood designers and glamorous starlets set the trends as people flocked to the movies in the 1930's. Rebecca Kemp-Brent shows how to recreate any neckline for a whole new look. programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Artists are known for taking an unconventional approach to their art – often introducing "non art" supplies to their work. First we look at stamped metal for inventive beads. Then Candie Cooper throws a curve and uses cookie tins for her project. Next Kate Richbourg throws out the loom for a lalique bracelet that is loom free. We'll finish up with artist Tammy Honaman as she manipulates right angle weave to turn it into shapes and beads.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Good things come in small packages. Create a mini book from a 3D kaleidoscope with Joe Rotella, a mini journal with Jenny Barnett Rohrs, and 3D sculptured surface for your journal with Kim Hupke. All today on Scrapbook Soup.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Living creatures are all around us in nature. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer begins with paper beetles; a fun and easy project drawing project. Then Cheryl Holz has a dragonfly portrait made with transparent overlays. Next Cat Kerr has a wall hanging made from an embroidery hoop featuring pigs. We finish with a nature inspired doodling meditation from Tori Weyers.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: The thing about quilting is there's always room to grow, even for the midnight quilter! This episode's all about reflecting on personal growth. Well, that and how to put a modern spin on a traditional block we all know and love.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela's been practicing her magic tricks! Tonight, she amazes with a magnificent optical illusion quilt. Watch as she uses solid pre-cuts to magically create her star blocks.

programme.desc: Hold onto your needles! Tracie and Jodi, are here to dish out fresh fiber inspiration. From project picks to wooly good gossip, things are about to get super knitty… and maybe just a little nutty.

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.desc: Forget wool and alpaca fiber; upcycled socks and grocery bags are where it's at! Tune in to find out how to turn any tubular (and cuttable) material into knittable yarn.

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.desc: What's the nicest style of knitting? Canadian, of course! Join Tracie and Jodi for a lesson in knitting styles, and find out what it takes to knit like a Canadian!

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.desc: Having trouble with your Fox Paws scarf? Well, you're not the only one! Luckily, designer Xandy is here to share her tips and tricks for navigating her famously intricate pattern.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: Today we take a very personal approach using our names and monograms. Our first projects are monogram ornaments made from air dry clay. Finally make an initial bulletin board covered with initials and doodle art.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: Let's turn toward ourselves for creative ideas. When she makes a lighted mirror, Jenny Barnett-Rohrs makes you a star. Katie Hacker makes personal paper dolls and Franz Spohn draws a 3D self-portrait. Jenny celebrates Thanksgiving with Pilgrim-style table decorations.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Wire wrapping is one of our all time favorite techniques; keep it fresh with these updates on tried and true techniques. programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Bend it, twist it, shape it, wear it. Jewelry designer Sandra Lupo warms up by bending and shaping sheet metal with a tool she invented. programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Let's liven things up! Joe Rotella makes a delightful owl clock. Cheryl Boglioli saves time as she creates colorful backgrounds for journals and scrapbooks. programme.title: Make It Artsy

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The atmosphere turns electric as the University of Florida and the University of North Carolina clash in a high-stakes pursuit of the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. With standout athletes like Brayden Drake delivering relentless energy, every rally becomes a testament to the "heat" these programs bring to the court. This episode showcases the full spectrum of collegiate pickleball, from high-speed Racing rallies to the precision of technical Skills and the flair of Freestyle play that keeps the opposition guessing. As the scoreline tightens at critical junctions like 15-13 and 20-16, the pressure reaches a fever pitch where only the most composed "Game boy" can lead their team to glory.

Don’t miss this showdown from the heart of England’s pickleball scene.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League Season 2 continues at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai with a high-stakes Tie 5 showdown. Pune United enters the arena hungry for their first points of the season, facing off against a confident Hyderabad Superstars squad coming off a fresh victory. Watch as top-tier athletes like Katie Morris, Shawn Mendes, and William Sobeck battle through a gauntlet of Women’s Singles, Mixed Doubles, and Men’s Doubles matches. With "hands battles" at the net and strategic "pickle plays" in full effect, every point is a testament to the speed and precision of professional pickleball.

With legendary co-owner Sunil Gavaskar watching from the sidelines, the Dilwale look to maintain their winning streak against a fiercely aggressive Hyderabad squad known for their wild celebrations and relentless energy. This tie features a series of high-octane clashes, from the strategic precision of Shawn Mendes and Alejandra Lopez in women’s singles to the "grueling" 15-minute sprints of elite doubles play. As the "Band of Honor" leaderboard hangs in the balance, every rally becomes a desperate fight for survival in one of the world's most prestigious pickleball arenas.

programme.desc: Witness a clash of collegiate giants as the University of Virginia and the University of Florida battle for a spot in the finals at Performance Pickleball RVA. Elite talent takes center stage, featuring former D1 tennis stars like Laura Font and Norwegian standout Martinez Sunstein facing off against Virginia’s deep roster of defending champions. From powerful serves to tactical kitchen play, every point counts in this high-stakes quest for a championship bid.

programme.desc: Experience the peak of collegiate pickleball as Arizona State University takes on the University of Virginia in a high-stakes battle for the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. This episode captures the high-energy "Racing" pace of elite rally scoring, where stars like Alexandra McDonald and David push the tempo with rapid-fire volleys and aggressive drives. Witness the incredible "Skills" displayed through precision resets and tactical timeouts as both teams fight through a grueling climb toward the 20-16 mark. The intensity reaches a fever pitch with "Freestyle" creativity on the court, highlighting a fierce rivalry where every point counts toward national glory.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: This Pro Women's Doubles match at the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships features the dynamic team of Anna Leigh Waters and Lee Waters facing off against the formidable duo of Walczak and Harris. The Waters team, known for their aggressive play and powerful shots, including Anna Leigh's unique heavy topspin cross-court backhand roll, aim to dominate the court. Walczak, a native of Poland with collegiate tennis experience, and Harris seek to overcome the Waters' early lead and challenge their expected path to the Championship court.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, hosts the Senior Women's Doubles Final under the floodlights . Team England, represented by Kirsty Gray and Anna Linton, faces off against Team Spain's Monica Ramirez and Araceli Senciales .After a strong start where England establishes an early lead, the match tightens as Spain finds their rhythm in the second game . Witness the strategic battle as Gray utilizes precision lobs to disrupt the Spanish defense , while Linton delivers powerful drives to secure critical points . In a high-stakes contest for the gold medal, England targets their opponents' positioning to close out the championship .

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: This championship game highlights the strategic play, including lobs and speed-ups, as both teams battle for the gold. A key dynamic of this match is that Courter and Carter had the advantage of playing under the shaded court conditions just before, while Dawson and Williams were coming from outside. Jen Dawson is noted as being a seasoned player on this court, having a triple crown in the Senior Pro divisions.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Virginia Super Regional semifinals deliver high-intensity action as the Clemson Tigers take on the UNC Tar Heels in a bid for the championship. Experience the elite skill of UNC's Sara Carpenter and the "Cinderella" play of Clemson's Fiorella Busetto in a women's doubles match where the lead never feels safe. With "March Madness" energy fueling every rally, the competition heats up as Kyle Compton brings a Dikembe Mutombo-style defensive presence to the court for the Tigers. Broadcast from Performance Pickleball RVA, this match captures the fierce rivalry and championship pedigree of two of the nation's top collegiate pickleball programs.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The inaugural DUPR Collegiate National Championship brings a high-stakes, "electric" atmosphere as TCU squares off against the powerhouse Utah Tech University in a thrilling semifinal matchup. Utah Tech enters with a dominant 70% win probability and brings unrelenting offensive pressure, forcing TCU to rely on incredible defense and a "slow and methodical" transition game. In the final mixed doubles game, the tension reaches an all-time high with a unique sibling rivalry on the line. With the score tied at 18-18 and the crowd roaring for TCU, both teams must fight through the cold weather and the intense pressure of rally scoring, where every single point could determine who advances to the finals.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Watch the Gold Medal match of the Women’s Pro Split Age division at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships, where Parris Todd and Beth Bellamy team up to face Sheri Courter and Mari Humberg. Featuring cross-generational strategy, fast hands, and smart positioning, this match highlights the unique synergy of Split Age play. Recorded live from Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: In this alternate cut of the Women’s Split Pro Doubles Quarterfinal at the 2024 US Open, Suzanne Leblang & Milan Rane face off against Martina Frantova & Christine Karges in a battle of shot placement, net pressure, and quick resets. Filmed in Naples, Florida, this matchup delivers a new perspective on one of the tournament’s most tactical and fast-paced doubles clashes.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: Experience the high-stakes intensity of collegiate pickleball as the powerhouse Utah Tech Trailblazers face off against a determined Utah State University squad in the regional semifinals. With a spot in the finals on the line, the match kicks off with a tactical women's doubles battle. The energy shifts as the men's doubles take the court, showcasing the explosive firepower of Logan Rosenbach and the home-court support for Aggie favorites Davis Weatherston and Parker Egli. Watch as both teams navigate the pressure of professional MLP rally scoring in this must-win "Beehive State" rivalry.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The undefeated Florida Atlantic University Owls face off against the underdog University of Miami Hurricanes in this intense collegiate showdown. Watch as these talented athletes leave it all on the court across thrilling Women's Doubles, Men's Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matchups. Both squads must push their limits for a highly coveted spot in the regional finals. Will Miami's aggressive energy be enough to disrupt the dominant rhythm of the heavily favored FAU team?

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional

Experience every powerful drive, strategic soft game, and emotional fist pump in this must-watch matchup between two of pickleball's premier programs.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Breadboard Ends - The Joint Most People Get Wrong
programme.desc: Four ways to make proper breadboard ends.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Fancy Raised Panel
programme.desc: As much as I would love to show you all the details of my current project, time just won’t allow it. But there is one specific part of the process I wanted to show you: making the raised panels.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fixing Common Woodworking Mistakes
programme.desc: Whether we like to admit it or not, mistakes will happen. Knowing how to repair them may make the difference between a nerve-wracking build and a relaxed one. So in this demo (recorded live), I'll show you some of the most common mistakes and errors I encounter and the various ways I like to fix them.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Philip Morley Shop Tour
programme.desc: A tour of Philip's shop in Texas.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Be a Safety Hero!
programme.desc: Last week I asked you folks for your favorite quick safety tips and you were kind enough to respond with some fun and insightful tricks of the trade. So I took a few of my favorites and bundled them up in this 50's style educational video. I hope you enjoy!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sitting Bench Step Stool Part 2
programme.desc: The sitting bench step stool comes to life with some additional shaping and assembly. The center support is joined to the legs using either wooden or brass dowels.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Visit To Fine Woodworking
programme.desc: We pay a visit to the offices of Fine Woodworking Magazine and The Taunton Press. It was a great experience and incredibly cool seeing how an initial idea becomes an article. This video gives you a behind the scenes look into that exact process. You’ll also get to see the Fine Woodworking shop and we’ll hear from numerous key staff members as they explain their roles in the process.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I Bought a Sawstop! - First Impressions
programme.desc: I bought a SawStop. Hopefully I won't regret it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Classy Headphone Controller Rack
programme.desc: An elegant and simple rack that holes a game controller and a set of headphones.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Installing Nordfab Ductwork
programme.desc: After installing the Clear Vue CV1800 cyclone, the next step was to install the Nordfab ductwork. This video shows you how I did the job and how this system works.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: David Marks Shop Tour
programme.desc: Last summer, on our Gadget Station delivery trip, we decided to stop and visit the one and only David Marks. If you’re not familiar with David, he is an incredible woodworker/designer and used to host a show on HGTV and the DIY Network called Woodworks. His show was a huge influence on me personally and I know thousands of other woodworkers feel the same way.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Compact Plane Till
programme.desc: A compact plane till is a great way to store your hand plane collection.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: My First 3-Phase Tool!
programme.desc: My first 3-Phase tool requires some specialized gear to get it working.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Which Festool Domino? Ask TWW
programme.desc: Future upgrades/expansions, Mortise Chisels, Finish for Gaming Dining Table and Walnut, Letting teak age naturally?, Which Festool Domino to purchase?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bit Storage Cabinet
programme.desc: A wall-hanging cabinet to help you organize and store your drill and router bits.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Relative Dimensioning
programme.desc: The idea is simple: let the pre-existing parts of your project dictate the size of subsequent parts. And in many cases, this is much easier and far more accurate than measuring with a tape or ruler.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Introduction to Milk Paint
programme.desc: Few finishes have the built-in sense of history as milk paint. Made from milk protein, pigment, and lime, this type of paint dates back to pre-recorded history. It smells like mud and doesn't feel anything like the modern latex paints most of us are familiar with today. That said, it actually provides a fairly durable finish and when topcoated, it's just as good as any other painting method.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Nicole’s Desk Pt. 4 - The Drawer and Finish
programme.desc: This series wraps up with the construction of the drawer and the application of the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Pet Steps
programme.desc: Sometimes our pets need a little help getting to high places like the family bed or the inside of a vehicle. This easy-to-build set of Pet Steps can also serve as a ramp and even stores flat when not in use. Made with simple materials and basic tools, anyone can knock this project out in a weekend.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. programme.desc: Once the cross-members are milled to length and width, I’ll use the Domino once again to create the mortises on the ends. I then use a hand-held router and a round-over bit to give the cross-members their final shape. During the routing process, I noticed a small knot that was easily repaired with some epoxy.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Tenons on the Bandsaw
programme.desc: If you are one of those folks who wants to begin detaching from the tablesaw, you're going to need to find alternative methods for doing the things that we typically use the tablesaw for, such as cutting tenons. Fortunately, the bandsaw is a very good alternative.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Visit To Fine Woodworking
programme.desc: We pay a visit to the offices of Fine Woodworking Magazine and The Taunton Press. It was a great experience and incredibly cool seeing how an initial idea becomes an article. This video gives you a behind the scenes look into that exact process. You’ll also get to see the Fine Woodworking shop and we’ll hear from numerous key staff members as they explain their roles in the process.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cut Your Own Veneer aka Wish You Veneer
programme.desc: Learn with Marc how to make your own veneer press.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Which Festool Domino? Ask TWW
programme.desc: Future upgrades/expansions, Mortise Chisels, Finish for Gaming Dining Table and Walnut, Letting teak age naturally?, Which Festool Domino to purchase?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Space-Saving Plywood Cart
programme.desc: A compact plywood cart that saves space and organize full sheets and scraps.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: AWFS 2009 – Overview and Belt Sander Races
programme.desc: If you aren’t familiar, AWFS is the Association of Woodworking & Furnishings Suppliers and its a show that occurs every other year at the Las Vegas Convention Center. This is just a quick video to give you an idea of what the show is like.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Coping Cabana
programme.desc: This is just a quick (silly) video of me assembling an Eagle America coping sled. I find this type of sled is not only helpful, but a necessity, when making frames and raised panel doors. It’s a great jig for running those narrow pieces through a big router bit.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Protecting Outdoor Furniture with Epoxy Feet
programme.desc: Mother Nature always wins. So when you make outdoor furniture you have two choices: commit to a regular maintenance schedule or come to terms with the weathered gray look. An easy thing you can do to help the cause is to prevent moisture from entering into the legs. This simple trick requires nothing more than epoxy and masking tape.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Guitar Pick Cutting Board
programme.desc: A triangular cutting board that will never wobble.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Jaguar F-Type Project 7 crosses the Pond.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Mustang Mayhem at the big show.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Red carpet receptions for a Koenigsegg Regera.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Covert cars that slipped into the U.S.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: "Go Fast Girl" Katherne Legge's Model A Racer.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Mecum Auction's push for a $15,000,000 sale.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Doubling down for cars and coffee.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: British Invasion through the decades.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.desc: Alex wants to become a father. Steven, his partner, has to confront his insecurities and fear of change after a lifetime smothered by superficiality. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

Ever the adventurer, Ellis dives into a lake that, according to local legend, is full of mysteries and monsters.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest
programme.desc: The Marshall Islands have a long human history, but it is the more recent saga that was thrust upon them during World War II and its aftermath that draws host Ellis Emmett to its shores. Following the Allied victory, the United States moved the local inhabitants from their quiet paradise in order to conduct atomic bomb testing at the famous Bikini Atoll. Ellis explores how, almost 65 years later, both the people and environment continue to be affected.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest
programme.desc: For thousands of years, the island peoples of the Pacific were masters of the ocean, sailing across the waves in handmade canoes and navigating by the stars. But, these traditional ways and sailing knowledge are being lost to technology. Host Ellis Emmett helps get a traditional canoe back on the water, and sees first-hand how rising seas are changing life in the island chains of Kiribati.

programme.title: Descending

programme.title: Into America's wild

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Usuarios de buses intermunicipales que sufrieron accidentes de tránsito denuncian que las empresas no les respondieron. Casos en Tolima, Cundinamarca y Bolívar muestran negligencia y falta de responsabilidad. Las víctimas buscan justicia y compensación por los daños sufridos.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Juan José, de 7 años, falleció ahogado en una piscina sin salvavidas en Melgar. Las familias buscan justicia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los padres luchan por mantener a sus hijos adolescentes y preadolescentes a salvo de los peligros de Internet.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Diana Ospina es contratada como administradora en dos conjuntos en Madrid, Cundinamarca, pero es acusada de desfalco por más de 300 millones de pesos. programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: La adicción de Juan Sebastián, abogado de 35 años, a las apuestas electrónicas lo llevó a perder casi todo y a un intento de suicidio.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Miles de familias colombianas buscan tener casa propia, pero muchas son engañadas. En Flandes, Freddy Hernández y su esposa Edna también fueron víctimas de un proyecto sin permisos. Las autoridades investigan.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, María Isabel Delgado y su hija Selena desaparecieron en Pasto, Nariño. Tras días de búsqueda, se reveló que Milton, esposo de María Isabel y también su primo, las había asesinado para ocultar que era padre de otra bebé fruto de una relación extramarital secreta. Los cuerpos fueron hallados enterrados con señales de violencia. Milton fue declarado autor intelectual del doble homicidio y condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2015, en Caquetá, cuatro niños fueron brutalmente asesinados en su casa. Pablo, el único sobreviviente, ayudó a resolver el caso años después. La investigación reveló que Luz Mila, en disputa por tierras con la familia Vanegas, contrató a Christopher Chávez, alias "El Desalmado", y su cómplice "Chencho" para cometer el crimen. Luz Mila fue condenada a cadena perpetua, Chávez a 40 años, y "Chencho" a 20 años.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Chinchiná, Caldas, en 2012, Angie, de 14 años, desapareció tras aceptar en secreto una cita con un hombre que le prometió un celular. Ocho días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en la vereda "La Pola". La verdad salió a la luz cuando Javier, un preso en Popayán, acusó a su propio hermano del asesinato de la menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en Socorro, Santander, Yesenia Bernal fue asesinada para robarle a su bebé recién nacido. Su amiga Edilsa María Díaz, tras perder su propio embarazo y temiendo perder a su pareja, fingió estar embarazada y planeó el crimen junto a Juan Carlos Vega para apropiarse de la niña. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados: Edilsa a 35 años y Juan Carlos a una pena similar.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Montañita, Caquetá, Jhon Jairo Marín rehace su vida con Yineth Mosquera, quien, celosa del hijo de su pareja, Esneider, termina atentando contra la vida del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Heily García, de 23 años y madre de cuatro hijos, fue asesinada en Cali en 2017. Su amiga Mayra Alejandra Ramírez, tras perder a su propio bebé, fingió estar embarazada y asesinó a Heily para quedarse con su recién nacida, Luciana, a quien luego abandonó. La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2008, Marco Iván Parrado, un menor de edad, desapareció en Arbeláez, Cundinamarca. Aunque se sospechó de un rapto por las FARC, un celular reveló su cuerpo abandonado en la selva. Las evidencias llevaron a Juan Carlos Mayorga, vigilante del pueblo con antecedentes de pedofilia, como el principal sospechoso del crimen.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Ariana García, de 19 años, está demandando a sus padres por angustia emocional y abuso, alegando que la negativa de sus padres a reconocer y respetar su privacidad y sus límites emocionales la ha llevado a perder amigos, confianza y negocios lucrativos como influencer de viajes.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Ricardo pasó de guerrillero a productor de insectos, usando moscas para la paz y el medio ambiente.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Lola, del icónico programa infantil Plaza Sésamo, comparte cómo ella y el equipo de producción se adaptaron a la pandemia mediante video llamadas para seguir conectando con los niños. También hablan sobre los programas humanitarios de la organización, incluyendo su iniciativa más reciente para ayudar a los niños refugiados sirios desplazados por más de una década de guerra en Medio Oriente.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Cinco años después del homicidio de Alonso Orjuela, dueño de Surtifruver, su exesposa Cecilia Rueda y su socio Mauricio Parra hablan por primera vez ante cámaras. Ambos estuvieron presos —ella acusada de complicidad, él de ser testaferro de las FARC— pero fueron liberados por vencimiento de términos. Ahora denuncian un montaje judicial y afirman tener pruebas de que no fue un crimen pasional.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri sintiéndose perseguida por el recuerdo de Wilker desaprovecha la oportunidad de estar íntimamente con Juan Diego al rehusarse a ser parte de su seducción. En el restaurante Briggite conversa con Carolina al intentar tranquilizarla tras ser testigo de la desaparición de Juan Diego del lugar | Carolina desahoga su frustración en contra de su madre al saberla envuelta en un insistente coqueteo con Armando | Carolina hace valer sus sospechas al presentir a Juan Diego y Yubiri juntos.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Aureliano confiesa a Dileidy que intenta superarse para merecerla. Gerson se siente asfixiado por Cristina. Paco aprovecha y culpa a Doroteo de intentar asesinarle. Matilde nota que Monchito está celoso de Pascuita.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela obliga a Ricardo a alejarse de Celia, quien cree estar embarazada. Hortensia descubre que Elizabeth es su nieta y se enorgullece de ella. Michelle ingresa a desintoxicación y Gregory conoce parte de la verdad sobre su madre. En la clínica, Celia provoca a Manuela hablándole de su supuesta maternidad. Ricardo se acerca a Elizabeth regalándole un celular, mientras Manuela rechaza tajantemente convivir con la hija de su esposo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Blanca recobra la memoria al despertar en la clínica reconociendo a Chencha y René. Alejandro persigue a Rosa y logra reconciliarse aclarando los enredos con Junior. Isaías regresa con Consuelo pidiendo perdón; ella lo acepta. Adolfo espera a Consuelo con el detective contratado. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto en la residencia, quien lo amenaza directamente. Arminda y Eustoquio conspiran contra Erasto al ver que no encuentra salida. Alejandro invita a Rosa al restaurant de un hotel para celebrar, sin sospechar que ese viaje desencadenará nuevos enfrentamientos con Rosalía y Amalia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe e Irene son interrumpidos por Paula, quien luego mantiene una charla con Irene pidiéndole que se alejara de Felipe para no hacerlo sufrir y que lo deje ser feliz al lado de otra persona. Carlos Ernesto tiene fuertes sospechas por la reaparición de Rebecca y decide emprender un viaje hacia la isla para obtener información del hospital en donde se trataba. Se lo lleva a Tony con él y deja a Maribel como informante en la empresa. Alejandra los vio conversando a los tres y tiene dudas de que se traigan algo entre manos. Rebecca recibe la visita de su padrino Adolfo con quien al parecer tienen un plan para obtener la fortuna de los Ferrandiz.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro tienen un par de encuentros en los que se ven en paños menores a lo que ambos responden con indiferencia tratando de ocultar sus emociones, hasta que Alejandro entra en la pieza de Sol y la besa y le dice que la desea. Sol le dice que no niega sentir algo por él pero que al mismo tiempo lo odia por no haber reconocido a su hija. Que por eso no va a pasar nada entre ellos. Eloy le propone matrimonio a Columba, luego aparece José Domingo y les desea la mejor de las suertes.

programme.desc: Manuela obliga a Ricardo a alejarse de Celia, quien cree estar embarazada. Hortensia descubre que Elizabeth es su nieta y se enorgullece de ella. Michelle ingresa a desintoxicación y Gregory conoce parte de la verdad sobre su madre. En la clínica, Celia provoca a Manuela hablándole de su supuesta maternidad. Ricardo se acerca a Elizabeth regalándole un celular, mientras Manuela rechaza tajantemente convivir con la hija de su esposo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Blanca recobra la memoria al despertar en la clínica reconociendo a Chencha y René. Alejandro persigue a Rosa y logra reconciliarse aclarando los enredos con Junior. Isaías regresa con Consuelo pidiendo perdón; ella lo acepta. Adolfo espera a Consuelo con el detective contratado. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto en la residencia, quien lo amenaza directamente. Arminda y Eustoquio conspiran contra Erasto al ver que no encuentra salida. Alejandro invita a Rosa al restaurant de un hotel para celebrar, sin sospechar que ese viaje desencadenará nuevos enfrentamientos con Rosalía y Amalia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carmen exige a Rosa no ver más a Junior por ser responsable de la muerte de Carlos. Junior golpea a Isaías al descubrirlo como acompañante nocturno de Maricela. Adolfo acorrala a Consuelo, quien confiesa entre lágrimas que tuvieron una hija perdida tras el embarazo. Rosalía descubre que Rosa trabaja en la tienda y la despide humillándola. Arminda, disfrazada, envenena el café de Blanca mientras Chencha la deja sola. Robert es elegido para una película por Amalia. La maldad de Erasto y Arminda continúa, cada vez más cerca de destruir todo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Blanca convulsiona repentinamente en pleno brindis y René la lleva urgente a la clínica reconociendo síntomas de envenenamiento. Arminda festeja con Erasto la supuesta muerte de Blanca. Erasto trae a Natalia a su casa y la humilla obligándola a quitarle los zapatos y desnudarlo. Arminda y Eustoquio quedan furiosos por distintas razones. Junior pide ayuda a Rosalía para separar a Rosa de Alejandro. Adolfo entra a un bar pensando en Consuelo sin tomar. Rosalía se insinúa a Alejandro al quedar solos en casa, marcando otro paso decisivo del engaño.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo visita a Erasto y le reprocha haber ocultado la existencia de su hija con Consuelo; Erasto lo expulsa. José Luis informa a la residencia que Blanca fue envenenada y Carmen acusa a la "amiga rara". Consuelo echa a Isaías tras llevarlo Rosa ebrio. Amalia descubre que Alejandro pasó la noche con Rosalía. Natalia confiesa a Mildred las humillaciones que vivió con Erasto. Carmen va a casa de Arminda a gritarle en la cara que ella envenenó a Blanca, pero que sigue viva. Maricela teme que Adolfo quiera quitarle su empresa.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto entra al hospital e intenta asfixiar a Blanca con una almohada, pero René lo sorprende y él lo golpea para huir. Adolfo besa a Consuelo concertando una cita con un detective para hallar a su hija. Junior delata ante Alejandro y Rosalía que sabe que durmieron juntos. Isaías cierra trato con un cliente para 30 mil dólares ilegales. José Luis acusa a Erasto frente a Arminda, quien lo expulsa de la casa. Consuelo destiende la cama y se lanza a llorar tras despedir a Adolfo, abrumada por todo el peso emocional.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Blanca recobra la memoria al despertar en la clínica reconociendo a Chencha y René. Alejandro persigue a Rosa y logra reconciliarse aclarando los enredos con Junior. Isaías regresa con Consuelo pidiendo perdón; ella lo acepta. Adolfo espera a Consuelo con el detective contratado. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto en la residencia, quien lo amenaza directamente. Arminda y Eustoquio conspiran contra Erasto al ver que no encuentra salida. Alejandro invita a Rosa al restaurant de un hotel para celebrar, sin sospechar que ese viaje desencadenará nuevos enfrentamientos con Rosalía y Amalia.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la celebración del matrimonio entre Atanasio y Gisela | Finita discute con Armando al amenazarlo con hacer un escándalo publico tras negarse a concederle su deseo de bailar con el | Armando en actitud irónica se enfrenta al desafío de Finita insistiendo en ignorar su petición al recordarle su decisión de conservar su matrimonio con Botero | Finita una ves mas obtiene una recompensa a sus esfuerzos al amedrentar a Armando con su chantaje de tornarse agresiva | Yubiri se lleva una sorpresa.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En su encuentro con Yubiri Wilker desahoga sus emociones en contra de la muchacha al sentirse decepcionado por su burlesca actitud | Yubiri se enfrenta a Wilker intentando así justificar su falta tras haber pasado la noche de celebración de la ceremonia entre Gisela y Atanasio en la compañía de Juan Diego. Carolina recibe la visita de Juan Diego haciéndole notar a este su enfado debido a su actitud de la noche anterior en la ceremonia de su padre | Juan Diego se excusa con Carolina.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Solymar visita la agencia de publicidad al sentirse movida por la culpa de creerse traicionando a su amiga Yubiri al haber aceptado un noviazgo con Wilker | Yubiri sintiéndose sorprendida por la noticia interroga a Solymar al verse sumergida en la ignorancia en cuanto a los sentimientos de su mejor amiga por Wilker | Solymar deja en manos de Yubiri la decisión de su relación con Wilker al sentirse decidida a acatar el mandato de su amiga para llevar a cabo o no su noviazgo.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la agencia de publicidad Briggite desconociendo la antigua relación amorosa y clandestina existente entre Finita y Armando se confiesa ante su amiga al informar a esta de sus continuas salidas con su ex amante | Finita se ve obligada a ocultar ante Briggite su frustración y sus celos al saberla ahora vinculada con el hombre que la llevo a traicionar sus principios de mujer casada para convertirse en su amante. En su encuentro con Wilker Yubiri desahoga ante este toda su frustración.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri sintiéndose perseguida por el recuerdo de Wilker desaprovecha la oportunidad de estar íntimamente con Juan Diego al rehusarse a ser parte de su seducción. En el restaurante Briggite conversa con Carolina al intentar tranquilizarla tras ser testigo de la desaparición de Juan Diego del lugar | Carolina desahoga su frustración en contra de su madre al saberla envuelta en un insistente coqueteo con Armando | Carolina hace valer sus sospechas al presentir a Juan Diego y Yubiri juntos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela deja a Ricardo tras descubrir su engaño con Celia y su hija Elizabeth. Mientras Celia celebra su éxito, Ricardo intenta recuperarla sin éxito y enfrenta la furia de Margot. Marcelo revela que ya sabía la verdad, provocando mayor tensión. Paralelamente, Misael es amenazado por criminales y Elizabeth confronta a su madre, quien admite haber enviado la foto reveladora. Desesperado, Ricardo promete eliminar a Celia de su vida definitivamente para intentar recuperar a Manuela.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela descubre que Ricardo tiene una hija de 14 años con Celia, una mujer considerada peligrosa por su entorno. René admite que conocía el secreto y Manuela lo perdona, mientras Joyce la aconseja no abandonar su relación todavía. En un arranque de ira, Ricardo intenta ahorcar a Celia por el envío de una foto, pero Elizabeth se culpa para protegerla. Finalmente, Hortensia se entera de la verdad sobre su nieta y acepta recibirla en su hogar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Marcelo intenta salvar el matrimonio de Ricardo y Manuela, mientras Katiuska y Verónica planean separarlos tras la partida de Graciela. Ricardo casi mata a Celia por sus intrigas, pero regresa con Manuela para darle otra oportunidad. Elizabeth enferma y es llevada al médico por Ricardo. Margot confronta a Hortensia, y Misael recurre a Manuela para rescatar a su sobrino Gregory. Finalmente, el Padre Alejandro usa sus habilidades de karate para rescatar al niño de unos delincuentes.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Margot le revela a Moisés que Malaver es su padre, mientras la abuela de Moisés lo niega. Ricardo rompe definitivamente con Celia, quien descubre que está embarazada de él. Jade nota un lunar en Moisés que confirma que es hermano de Elizabeth. Katiuska manipula a Manuela para que busque a Celia. Finalmente, Ricardo y Manuela tienen una fuerte discusión donde ella le exige jurar que nunca tuvo una relación con Celia, dejando a Ricardo sin palabras.
